statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-10536: libcurl frees an HTTP/2 stream-dependency tree in curl_easy_reset() and touches it again in curl_easy_cleanup() when an application set it with CURLOPT_STREAM_DEPENDS or CURLOPT_STREAM_DEPENDS_E, a use-after-free. curl 7.88.0 to 8.20.0 are affected; 8.21.0 fixes it by removing stream dependency tracking (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-10536.html, https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/bfbff7852f050232edd3e5ca5c6bf2021c340f5a, contained in the curl-8_21_0 release tag). Unpacked every published curl package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64, as curl, libcurl, curl-dev, curl-static, curl-dbg, curl-doc, curl-fish-completion and curl-zsh-completion. Their programs and shared libraries are the curl program and the libcurl.so.4 shared library, both dynamically linked against musl. libcurl links OpenSSL, zlib, c-ares, nghttp2, libidn2, libpsl, zstd and brotli; 8.17.0-r1 and 8.18.0-r0 also link nghttp3; no ELF file links an SSH library (libssh2, libssh or wolfSSH), an LDAP library or GnuTLS. curl-static ships the static libcurl.a, whose members are all libcurl's own object files; curl-dbg holds only detached debug information for curl and libcurl. No package contains a PE or Mach-O file. The libcurl.so.4 in each build reports the curl release of its package version. Builds 8.17.0-r1 to 8.20.0-r1 carry an affected curl release without a backport: their debug information still contains Curl_data_priority_add_child, part of the dependency-tree code the fix removes. 8.21.0-r0 and every later build package curl 8.21.0 or newer, and that function is gone. Alpine's curl APKBUILD lists this CVE under its 8.22.0-r0 secfixes (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/856d76205ed1b7f875d32fd7b72eb93912f32acd/main/curl/APKBUILD), but the fix is already in upstream 8.21.0, which 8.21.0-r0 packages. The range ends at 8.21.0-r0.
